description: This file defines a set of tools for interacting with the Google Drive API, including operations such as listing, creating, updating, deleting, copying, downloading files and folders, sharing, and permission management. It also provides a factory function to create these tools based on specified actions.

classes.name: BaseGoogleDriveTool
classes.description: Base class for Google Drive tools, providing request handling with authentication.

classes.name: ListFilesTool
classes.description: Tool for listing files in Google Drive.

classes.name: GetFileTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving file metadata from Google Drive.

classes.name: CreateFileTool
classes.description: Tool for creating new files in Google Drive.

classes.name: UpdateFileTool
classes.description: Tool for updating file metadata in Google Drive.

classes.name: DeleteFileTool
classes.description: Tool for deleting files from Google Drive.

classes.name: CopyFileTool
classes.description: Tool for copying files within Google Drive.

classes.name: DownloadFileTool
classes.description: Tool for downloading files from Google Drive.

classes.name: CreateFolderTool
classes.description: Tool for creating folders in Google Drive.

classes.name: SearchFilesTool
classes.description: Tool for searching files in Google Drive.

classes.name: ShareFileTool
classes.description: Tool for sharing files in Google Drive.

classes.name: ListFolderContentsTool
classes.description: Tool for listing contents of a folder.

classes.name: GetPermissionsTool
classes.description: Tool for retrieving permissions of a file.

classes.name: RemovePermissionTool
classes.description: Tool for removing permissions from a file.

methods.name: makeGoogleDriveRequest
methods.description: Performs an authenticated request to the Google Drive API.
